The review re-derived each reviewer's headline figures with a second reader: the gates with one that shares no code with readlib.py (review/verify_faithful/myread.py), the by-dose and per-neuron figures with code built on readlib's parts (review/verify_dose/vcore.py, review/verify_license/verify.py).

licensed_by_the_rules.rules: prereg text: 'All pass: whole layers at L40-50, plus 51-57 if the probe passes.' 'L57 probe: the scope extends to L51-57 only if S1-S3 and G5 hold.' 'max_new rule: the whole layer takes 32 pieces only if the 32-piece reading also passes G1-G5 and lies no more than 0.02 below the 48-piece reading on mass_c and on the lower of rep_AB and rep_BA. Otherwise it takes 48.'
licensed_by_the_rules.L40-50: whole layers, at 32 word-pieces (L45's 32-piece reading passes every gate computed there; drops 0.0067 on mass_c (0.0066 unrounded) and 0.0156 on the lower rep, the two measures the rule checks; it names 191 where 48 names 262, and its residual falls 0.0215)
licensed_by_the_rules.L51-57: whole layers, at 48 word-pieces: the probe passed at 48 and failed S2 at 32 (0.5061), and the hashed per-run reader gives take_shorter False there; 32 at L51-57 would need an amendment
licensed_by_the_rules.not_settled_by_the_rules: nothing is marked calibrated yet: census.DOSES_CALIBRATED stays () until the owner records which layers it covers

departures: morning.sh imported backend/census.py from the worktree at 372baec, not e94eea6, the runs' commit: the two differ only in comments, DOSES_FROM's text and DOSES_CALIBRATED, none of which the reader uses; the second reader, which imports neither, gives every gate exactly

python -I without -B wrote prereg/__pycache__/readlib.cpython-312.pyc during the read (13:51:37Z); trial_read's, at 13:58:04Z, was almost certainly written by the review's by-dose reader (its common.py imports trial_read from that folder, and its own bytecode was written 0.4 s earlier); neither is hashed, the sources are unchanged and sha256sum -c still passes
the pass criterion's prose quotes the calibration's L45 rep_BA as 0.65; calib_expect.json gives 0.591 (trial_read.py's comment has it right)

the 32-piece reading cuts the 48-piece answers with the tokenizer rather than coming from a 32-piece run (greedy decoding is causal, so the first 32 pieces are the same; 0 decode mismatches), and G5b, the units file's check, is computed at 48 only

review.how: six agents (review/): three readers (faithfulness, the lead by dose, what the rules license), each followed by an adversarial verifier that re-derived its headline figures and marked each claim as standing or falling (review/result.json); CPU only
review.faithful: read as pre-registered; hashes, runs, metas, neuron lists (rebuilt from their draws), completeness (2,110 and 1,019 units x 24 cells, job digests rebuilt) and every gate AUC reproduce; G5b's 0.0005 is the units file's 3-place rounding

units_with_all_pm1_answers_fluent.fluent: distinct-4 at least 0.9 on all 12 of the unit's +-1 answers; the figures are the +-1-only reading, about two-thirds of the pooled lead above chance

L45_by_dose.reading: the pass is carried by the +-1 answers; at +-2 neurons and controls alike collapse into loops on the same words (own, thought, same; distinct-4 0.210 against 0.208), and pooling them adds 0.008, though alone +-2 still holds a weak lead (5.6 SE above chance; 88 fresh neurons at p<=0.05 on it, about 51 by chance); the +-1-only figures were read after the fact

L45_per_neuron.picked_on_A_found_on_B: 120 of 161 (75%), against 7 of the 51 strongest controls
L45_per_neuron.A_words_scored_on_B: 147 of 161 (91%), against 10 of the 51 strongest controls
L45_per_neuron.false_named_of_262: about 7 (a point estimate that takes every neuron as null; 95% upper bound about 14), from the controls named by the same rule
L45_per_neuron.tail_vs_bulk: rho 0.558 for the 255 neurons above the controls' 95th percentile on half A, 0.168 for the other 767 (controls in that range 0.116): the order within the layer lies in the tail, though the 767 still lead the controls as a group (AUC 0.609 on half B); at L57 the bulk keeps more order (0.345 against 0.171)
L45_per_neuron.calibration_named_0: forced: with 64 neurons and 64 controls BH needs 20 above every control; it had 15
L45_per_neuron.inside_controls_covariate_range: 893 of the 1,022 fresh neurons clear every gate on their own (0.692, 0.691, 0.657/0.643, 0.651); picked on A and found on B, 73 of 91 against 0 of 3 controls

review.L45_early_breaking: named neurons' +-1 answers loop (distinct-4 below 0.5) in 9.6% of cases, fresh neurons 4.1%, controls 0.4%; of the named's 303 looping answers 135 loop on their own top words, 127 on the collapse words, 41 on neither
review.labels: 194 of the 262 named list same, own or thought among their replicated words (206 a collapse word of any kind: these and thoughtthought, ownthought, idea, and, owns); with L45's 789 collapse words (every word holding thought, and every word 10 or more controls hold in 2 or more of their +-2 answers) removed from every answer every gate still passes (0.711, 0.724, 0.677/0.671, 0.652; 294 named); 'same' is not purely a breakdown word (30% of the named's answers holding it are fluent +-1 text); a page should not show these as a neuron's words

L57.named_weight_from_broken_answers: 82% from answers with distinct-4 below 0.9 (controls 49%, nearly all at +-2; all 507 neurons 60%); many loop on pieces such as sem, pemb, ngày, though about half their words are ordinary (patriotic, vendor, volt, deck, support, personal, well)
L57.S2_bootstrap_with_refit: SD 0.025, 95% CI 0.512-0.609, 49% of 1,000 resamples below 0.56 (verify_faithful; verify_license's refit gives SD 0.024, CI 0.516-0.610)
L57.reading: the probe's pass rests on neurons whose text survival no control matches, where the residual is a linear extrapolation: this design cannot tell layer 57's lead from how the text survives

review.sanity_checks: the read gain is computed from the weights alone before any answer (at 57 the controls are read 1.18x as loudly); the relabelled-control split cannot name anything (1.4 fake neurons above every control against a floor of 20), so it shows only that the reading favours neither label
review.max_new_cost_at_L45: 32 pieces: named 262 to 191, q05 310 to 231, residual 0.724 to 0.703

owner_decisions: which layers DOSES_CALIBRATED covers (the rules license 40-57; the review finds 51-57's lead not separable from text survival)
the word-piece count at 40-50 (the rule gives 32: about 4 h a layer less, about a quarter fewer named)
whether +-2 stays (half the answers; at L45 it adds 0.008; at L57 the pass needs it); a design without it is a new design, and the +-1-only figures were read after the fact
1,024 or 2,048 controls a layer (BH needs 420 or 210 neurons above every control before any q<=0.05)
the default design, the first layer, and merging the branch
what a page says a lead means (open question 6: 'unlike a unit(w_post*r) direction pushed as far', not 'has a theme'); the review's figures support that wording at 51-57 and for the bulk at 45
